# FontHeight

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Fonts and Text](BlitzBasic-Fonts-and-Text)

```blitzbasic
FontHeight  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

The height in pixels of a character of the current font, as set by [SetFont](SetFont). Use it to place lines of text below each other.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
Local small = LoadFont("Arial", 8)
Local big = LoadFont("Arial", 24)
SetFont small
Text 10, 10, "Small: " + FontWidth() + " x " + FontHeight()
SetFont big
Text 10, 40, "Big: " + FontWidth() + " x " + FontHeight()
Flip
WaitKey
```

**Returns:** The height of a character in pixels.

**Differences and known gaps:**

* Fonts are the built-in 8x8 pixel bitmap font, scaled to the requested height. All characters have the same size, so FontHeight and [FontWidth](FontWidth) give the same number.
